meta.promptText: Which serum should I buy for acne-prone skin in India under ₹700?

response.text:
For acne-prone skin, the best type of serum to look for will depend on whether you are trying to clear active breakouts/clogged pores or fade leftover dark spots.

Here are some top-rated, budget-friendly options available in India well under ₹700:

### 1. For Active Acne, Blackheads, and Clogged Pores (Salicylic Acid Serums)

Salicylic Acid (BHA) is an oil-soluble exfoliant that penetrates deep into pores to clear out trapped sebum, dirt, and dead skin cells causing breakouts.

* **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Serum**
  *   * **Price:** Around ₹549 (frequently discounted online)[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/dp/salicylic-acid-serum#:~:text=Buy%20Salicylic%20Acid%20Serum%20Online%20*%20Bestseller.,Acne%20Day%2BNight.%20%E2%82%B9249%E2%82%B92375%25%20Off.%20Dot%20%26%20Key.)
  * **Why it’s great:** It contains 2% salicylic acid along with LHA for gentle multi-layer exfoliation, plus soothing ingredients to minimize irritation.
* **The Derma Co. 2% Salicylic Acid Face Serum**
  *   * **Price:** Around ₹549 (frequently lower with active sales)[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/dp/salicylic-acid-serum#:~:text=Buy%20Salicylic%20Acid%20Serum%20Online%20*%20Bestseller.,Acne%20Day%2BNight.%20%E2%82%B9249%E2%82%B92375%25%20Off.%20Dot%20%26%20Key.)
  * **Why it’s great:** Formulated with witch hazel and willow bark, it helps control excess oil and target active pimples.[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/dp/salicylic-acid-serum#:~:text=Price%20dropped%20by%20%E2%82%B954.%20The%20Ordinary.%20Salicylic,Betaine%203%25%20Serum.%20%E2%82%B9349%E2%82%B927920%25%20Off.%20The%20Ordinary.)

### 2. For Acne Marks and Post-Breakout Scars (Niacinamide Serums)

If your active breakouts have calmed down but you are left with dark spots or uneven texture, Niacinamide (Vitamin B3) is ideal.

* **Plum 10% Niacinamide Brightening Face Serum (with Rice Water)**
  *   * **Price:** Around ₹550 to ₹650[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/acne-friendly-skincare/c/63256#:~:text=Table_title%3A%20Acne%20Friendly%20Skincare%20Price%20List%20Table_content%3A,Last%20Updated%3A%20August%2013%2C%202026%20%7C%20%7C)
  * **Why it’s great:** It helps fade stubborn post-acne hyperpigmentation, balances oil production, and is soothing on sensitive skin types.[www.purplle.com](https://www.purplle.com/magazine/article/best-niacinamide-serums-for-oily-skin-under-500-in-india-2026#:~:text=Niacinamide%20is%20a%20form%20of%20vitamin%20B3,Why%20Niacinamide%20Works%20for%20Oily%20Indian%20Skin.)
* **Minimalist 10% Niacinamide Face Serum (with Zinc)**
  *   * **Price:** Around ₹599[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/acne-friendly-skincare/c/63256#:~:text=De-Tan%20Face%20Mask%20For%20Tan%20Removal%2C%20Instant,Skin.%20%E2%82%B9499%E2%82%B944910%25%20Off.%20Price%20dropped%20by%20%E2%82%B949.)
  * **Why it’s great:** The added zinc helps regulate sebum production while niacinamide works to clear up blemishes and smooth skin texture.[www.purplle.com](https://www.purplle.com/magazine/article/best-niacinamide-serums-for-oily-skin-under-500-in-india-2026#:~:text=The%20three%20best%20niacinamide%20serums%20for%20oily,Plum%20layers%20rice%20ferment%20for%20texture%20smoothing%3B)

### Quick Tips Before Buying:

* **Patch Test:** Always test a small amount of product on your inner elbow or jawline for 24 hours to check for any allergic reactions or irritation.
* **Start Slow:** If using a chemical exfoliant like salicylic acid, start by applying it only 2–3 times a week so your skin can build tolerance.
* **Sun Protection:** Active serums can make your skin more sensitive to the sun, so always follow up with a sunscreen during the day.

Would you prefer a recommendation focused more on treating active pimples or fading existing dark spots?
